title: Pure Myutant
summary: Pure Myutant build with only Myutant Main and Extra Deck cards plus generic staples. Small Psychic Myutants tribute themselves and banish a Monster, Spell, or Trap to evolve into a matching Level 8 boss from the Deck, feeding banished materials into Fusion Summons on both turns.

summary.title: Starters
points: Myutant M-05 searches any Myutant monster besides itself when Normal or Special Summoned.
Myutant ST-46 searches any Myutant Spell or Trap when Normal or Special Summoned.

Myutant Mutant Special Summons itself while you control a Myutant card, then tributes itself and banishes a Myutant card from the Deck to summon the matching Level 8 Myutant at the cost of LP equal to its original ATK.
Myutant Evolution Lab Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Myutant from your hand or banishment on activation.

summary.title: Opening: Myutant M-05
steps: Normal Summon Myutant M-05 and search Myutant Mutant (or Myutant ST-46 if you already have Mutant).
Special Summon Myutant Mutant from the hand, then tribute Mutant and banish a Myutant Spell/Trap or Monster from the Deck to summon Myutant Beast, Mist, or Arsenal from the Deck.
Tribute Myutant M-05 and banish a card from your hand or field to summon a second Level 8 Myutant, and Set Myutant Cry or Myutant Expansion for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Mutation Matching
summary.text: Which card type you banish when tributing M-05, ST-46, or Mutant dictates which Level 8 boss emerges from the Deck or hand: banishing a Monster summons Myutant Beast, banishing a Spell summons Myutant Mist, and banishing a Trap summons Myutant Arsenal. Each Level 8 is untargetable by the opponent's cards of a specific type and floats into a banished Myutant of a different type when destroyed by the opponent.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Myutant Beast banishes a card from your hand or field to negate and banish an opponent's Spell activation; Myutant Mist banishes a card to draw 2 cards when they activate a Trap; Myutant Arsenal banishes a card to banish a monster on the field when they activate a monster effect.

Myutant Synthesis (2 Myutants with different Attributes) destroys a card on the field when Fusion Summoned and can make itself unaffected by opponent's cards of one type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) for the turn.

Myutant Ultimus (3 Level 8+ Myutants) negates any card or effect by banishing a Myutant card of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your hand, GY, or field, and recovers up to 3 banished Myutants when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Myutant Fusion banishes materials from the hand or field to Fusion Summon, and if the opponent has activated a card or effect this turn, it can also banish materials from the Deck and GY.
Myutant Cry Fusion Summons a Myutant during either Main Phase by shuffling materials from your field, GY, and banishment back into the Deck.

Myutant Expansion summons or adds a Level 4 or lower Myutant on activation and banishes itself to protect a Level 8+ Myutant from destruction; Myutant GB-88 summons itself on the opponent's turn while Myutant Evolution Lab is active to swap into a banished Level 8 or Fusion.
